messages:
rachael: kicking off canary roll v2.6.2 -> canary @ 8% (change window 03:30-04:15 UTC). tagging @mike @tara for post-deploy smoke.
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: rollout started · target=8% · variant=v2.6.2 · checks=healthcheck,synth-ping,mem-sample
mike: starting synth-ping + mem-sample watchers. will report failures.
ops-runner: quick glance at infra: node pressure looks normal pre-roll.
deploy-bot: initial checks OK · healthcheck:ok · synth-ping:ok · mem-sample:ok
mike: mem-sample: saw heapRSS climb from 420MB -> 620MB on canary-a over 6m after first traffic spike. still under OOM but steady growth.
tara: any GC spam in logs?
mike: yes, canary-a shows frequent stop-the-world GC at ~20s intervals starting 03:38. stack traces point to tokenizer cache fill.
rachael: pause auto-ramp. keep at 8% and cordon canary-a from new allocations for now.
deploy-bot: AUTO-RAMP: paused · canary weight frozen at 8% · cordon applied to pod canary-a
ops-runner: moving traffic off canary-a, rebalancing.
mike: rerunning warmup and reduced-batch warm requests against remaining pods. mem growth stabilized on others.
tara: suggestion: apply hotfix that disables tokenizer caching for canary variant (toggle env TOK_CACHE=false) and redeploy canary pods. if mem trend stops, resume ramp.
rachael: agreed. @mike can you push env toggle to canary config? if not fixed in 10m rollback.
mike: pushing patch: `kubectl set env deploy/canary-v2-6-2 TOK_CACHE=false -n prod-canary`
deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: config update detected · env TOK_CACHE=false applied to selector canary=true
mike: new pods spinning up with toggle. monitoring mem-sample.
deploy-bot: mem-sample update · canary-a:cordoned canary-b:stable canary-c:stable · global p95 mem 450MB -> 435MB
rachael: looks better. trending down on canary-b/c. hold at 8% for 12m then step to 25% if stable. rollback command ready if it toggles back: `deployctl rollback --to v2.6.1 --reason "canary mem leak"`
tara: I'll add a note in release notes about tokenizer cache change and an ops runbook entry for TOK_CACHE toggle.
mike: will collect heap profiles and open a quick issue for tokenizer team.
rachael: thanks all. keeping window open 03:30-04:15 UTC. will update if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
